display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — Monthly GMV Trend
formula_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(order_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  COUNT_IF(transaction_type = 'forward') AS forward_orders,
  COUNT_IF(transaction_type = 'reverse') AS return_orders,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
